namespace Example.Scoped;

/// <summary>A shape.</summary>
public interface IShape
{
    /// <summary>The area.</summary>
    double Area();
}

/// <summary>A pair.</summary>
public struct Pair
{
    /// <summary>A nested type.</summary>
    public class Inner { }
}

/// <summary>A handler.</summary>
public delegate void Handler(int x);

#if DEBUG
// Inside a region only a debug build reads.
public static class DebugOnly { }
#endif
